department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
description: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi provides income support of Rs. 6000 per year to all landholding farmer families across India to supplement their financial needs.
eligibility: All landholding farmers' families whose names appear in land records.
benefits: Rs. 6,000 per year (Rs. 2,000 every 4 months — three equal installments) directly credited to bank account.
incomeCriteria: No income limit; excludes govt employees, taxpayers, institutional landholders.
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Land Ownership Documents (Pattadar Passbook/Khasra), Mobile Number
applicationProcess: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in or visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). Farmer submits application via Village Patwari/Lekhpal.
officeToVisit: Common Service Centre (CSC) or Local Agriculture Office
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: Is it for all farmers? A: Yes, for all landholding farmer families. Q: How many installments? A: 3 installments of Rs.2000 each per year.

department: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare / National Health Authority
description: World's largest government-funded health insurance scheme. Provides health cover of Rs. 5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization. Expanded in 2024 to include all citizens above 70 years.
eligibility: Families identified through SECC 2011 data (AB-PMJAY list) and all senior citizens aged 70+ years regardless of income.
benefits: Cashless health coverage up to Rs. 5 Lakhs per family per year for 1961+ medical procedures at empanelled hospitals.
incomeCriteria: BPL families / SECC 2011 identified; Senior Citizens 70+ have no income restriction.
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card, Ration Card / PMJAY e-Card (download from mera.pmjay.gov.in)
applicationProcess: No formal enrolment for existing beneficiaries. Senior citizens 70+ can self-enrol via Ayushman App or PMJAY portal.
officeToVisit: Any Ayushman Bharat empanelled hospital or CSC
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: Is there a cap on family size? A: No cap on family size or age (for existing beneficiaries). Q: Does it cover OPD? A: Currently OPD is not covered, only hospitalization.

schemeName: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
description: Launched in February 2024, this scheme subsidizes rooftop solar panel installation for 1 crore households and provides 300 units of free electricity per month.
eligibility: Households with valid electricity connection, not having an existing rooftop solar system.
benefits: Up to 300 units of free electricity per month via rooftop solar. Central subsidy up to Rs. 78,000 for a 3kW system. Collateral-free bank loans at subsidized interest rates.
incomeCriteria: No income cap. Priority to EWS/LIG households.
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card, Electricity Bill (DISCOM consumer number), Bank Passbook, House Ownership Document
applicationProcess: 1. Register at pmsuryaghar.gov.in. 2. Apply for rooftop solar. 3. Get approval from your DISCOM. 4. Install solar via registered vendor. 5. Net-meter installation and subsidy credit.
officeToVisit: Local Electricity Distribution Company (DISCOM) office or online portal
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: Is there a limit on system size? A: Subsidy is available up to 3kW; higher capacity allowed but subsidy capped. Q: Can renters apply? A: No, only legal house owners.

department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: PMAY-U 2.0, launched in 2024, aims to construct 1 crore urban housing units for EWS, LIG, and MIG families by 2029 through four verticals — Beneficiary-Led Construction, Affordable Housing, Rental Housing, and Subsidized Housing.
eligibility: EWS (Annual income up to Rs. 3L), LIG (Rs. 3L–6L), MIG (Rs. 6L–9L) urban families who do not own a pucca house anywhere in India.
benefits: Interest subsidy of 4% on home loans up to Rs. 9 lakhs (for EWS/LIG); direct financial assistance of up to Rs. 2.5 lakhs for beneficiary-led construction.
incomeCriteria: EWS: upto Rs. 3 Lakh; LIG: Rs. 3–6 Lakh; MIG: Rs. 6–9 Lakh per annum
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Property/Plot Documents, Bank Account, Self-declaration of no pucca house
applicationProcess: Apply through Urban Local Body (ULB) or at pmaymis.gov.in. Verify eligibility, submit documents online, and track application.
officeToVisit: Urban Local Body (Municipal Office) or online portal
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: Can someone with land apply? A: Yes, under Beneficiary-Led Construction component. Q: Does MIG get subsidy too? A: Yes, 3% interest subsidy on loans up to Rs. 12L.

department: Ministry of Rural Development / DAY-NRLM
description: Women in Self-Help Groups (SHGs) are trained in skill development and micro-enterprise creation to enable each SHG member to earn at least Rs. 1 Lakh per year. Target raised to 3 crore women in 2024 Budget.
eligibility: Women members of registered Self-Help Groups (SHGs) under DAY-NRLM.
benefits: Skill training (drone piloting, plumbing, LED repair, etc.), financial literacy, market linkage, capital infusion, and bank credit support.
incomeCriteria: BPL/rural poor women
requiredDocuments: SHG Member ID / SHG Passbook, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook
applicationProcess: Apply through Block Mission Management Unit (BMMU) or local SHG Federation. Enrol in relevant skills training programme.
officeToVisit: Block NRLM Office or District Rural Development Agency (DRDA)
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: Can urban women apply? A: No, only rural SHG members under DAY-NRLM. Q: Is there a cash benefit? A: It is skill and enterprise support, not a direct cash transfer.

department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
description: Launched in September 2023 (ongoing 2024+), it supports traditional artisans and craftspeople from 18 identified trades (carpenters, blacksmiths, goldsmiths, potters, weavers, etc.) with skill upgradation, modern tools, and collateral-free loans.
eligibility: Artisans and craftspeople engaged in one of 18 traditional trades, working with hands and tools in unorganized sector. One member per family.
benefits: Rs. 500/day stipend during training; Modern toolkit kit worth Rs. 15,000; Collateral-free business loan — Rs. 1 Lakh (1st tranche) and Rs. 2 Lakh (2nd tranche) at 5% interest; PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card.
incomeCriteria: No income cap
ageCriteria: 18+ (must NOT be in government service or receiving benefit under PMEGP/PM SVANidhi/Mudra)
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card, Mobile linked to Aadhaar, Bank Account, Proof of trade occupation
applicationProcess: Register at pmvishwakarma.gov.in or via CSC. Verification is done by Gram Panchayat/ULB. Attend training at designated institutes.
officeToVisit: Common Service Centre (CSC) or District Industries Centre (DIC)
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: Who are the 18 trades? A: Carpenter, Boat Maker, Armourer, Blacksmith, Hammer and Tool Kit Maker, Locksmith, Goldsmith, Potter, Sculptor, Cobbler, Mason, Basket/Mat/Broom Maker, Doll/Toy Maker, Barber, Garland Maker, Washerman, Tailor, Fishing Net Maker. Q: Is it monthly salary? A: No, it's a one-time toolkit grant plus training stipend plus loan support.

schemeName: PM SVANidhi – PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Provides affordable working capital loans to street vendors to restart livelihoods impacted by COVID-19. Now expanded with enhanced credit limits and digital transaction incentives.
eligibility: Street vendors operating in urban areas with a Certificate of Vending issued by Urban Local Body (ULB). Vendors without certificate can also apply via Letter of Recommendation from ULB.
benefits: Loan of Rs. 10,000 (1st round), Rs. 20,000 (2nd round), Rs. 50,000 (3rd round). Additional 7% per annum subsidy on timely repayment. Digital transaction cashback up to Rs. 1,200/year.
incomeCriteria: No income cap
requiredDocuments: Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation from ULB, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook
applicationProcess: Apply at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or through scheduled commercial banks, microfinance institutions, SHG banks.
officeToVisit: Urban Local Body (Municipal Office) or nearest bank branch
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: Does the vendor need to be registered? A: No formal registration needed; Letter of Recommendation from Town Vending Committee or ULB suffices. Q: Is it a grant or loan? A: It is a loan with interest subsidy.

department: Ministry of Finance / MUDRA (Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency)
description: Provides collateral-free loans to non-farm, non-corporate small/micro enterprises for starting or expanding businesses.
eligibility: Non-farm small/micro enterprises — individuals, SMEs, hobbyist entrepreneurs, startups in manufacturing, trading, services sector.
benefits: Shishu: Loans upto Rs. 50,000; Kishore: Rs. 50,001 to Rs. 5 Lakh; Tarun: Rs. 5 Lakh to Rs. 10 Lakh. No collateral required.
incomeCriteria: No income cap
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Recent Passport Photograph, Business Plan / Activity Details, Bank Statement (last 6 months)
applicationProcess: Apply at any Public Sector Bank, RRB, Cooperative Bank, MFI, or NBFC. Also apply online at udyamimitra.in.
officeToVisit: Nearest bank branch or MUDRA lending institution
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: Can women entrepreneurs get extra benefit? A: Yes, women get preferential interest rates. Q: Is there a processing fee? A: Generally no processing fee for Shishu loans.

department: Ministry of Women and Child Development / Ministry of Health / Ministry of Education
description: Multi-ministry scheme to address declining child sex ratio and promote welfare and education of the girl child.
eligibility: Girl children across India. No specific income restriction; focuses on BPL and low sex ratio districts.
benefits: Educational scholarships for girls; awareness campaigns; conditional cash benefits in some states; nutrition and healthcare support.
incomeCriteria: None (universal)
requiredDocuments: Birth Certificate, Parents' Aadhaar Card, School Enrolment Certificate
applicationProcess: Implemented through district level offices, ASHA workers, and school enrollment drives. Contact local ICDS (Anganwadi) office.
officeToVisit: Anganwadi Centre or Block Development Office
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: Is the cash benefit national? A: Financial assistance components are state-specific. Q: Does it cover healthcare too? A: Yes, through convergence with health department.

department: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship / National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC)
description: PMKVY 4.0 (2022–2026) focuses on industry-relevant skills including new-age technologies like AI, robotics, drones, 3D printing, IoT, coding, mechatronics, and green skills. Aims to train 1.4 crore youth.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 15–45 years seeking skill training. Includes school dropouts, unemployed youth, and industry workers seeking upskilling.
benefits: Free skill training at NSDC-affiliated training centres; Government certification (recognized nationally and globally); financial rewards for certified candidates; job placement assistance.
incomeCriteria: No income limit; priority to economically weaker sections
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card, Education Certificate, Bank Passbook, Passport Size Photograph
applicationProcess: Register at skillindiadigital.gov.in or pmkvyofficial.org. Find nearest training partner, enrol in preferred course, attend training, pass assessment, get certified.
officeToVisit: Nearest NSDC Training Partner / National Skill Training Institute (NSTI)
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: Is the training free? A: Yes, completely free. Q: Is there a stipend? A: Stipend was offered in earlier versions; PMKVY 4.0 offers placement support instead.

schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
department: Ministry of Finance / Department of Financial Services
description: A government-backed term life insurance scheme offering life cover at a very low annual premium.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18 to 50 years having a savings bank account.
benefits: Life insurance cover of Rs. 2 Lakhs in case of death due to any reason at annual premium of only Rs. 436.
incomeCriteria: No income limit
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card, Bank Account linked with mobile number, Consent form
applicationProcess: Enrol via your bank's internet banking, mobile banking, or by visiting bank branch. Auto-renewal each year on June 1.
officeToVisit: Any nationalized or private bank branch
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: What is the annual premium? A: Rs. 436 per year (auto-debited on June 1 each year). Q: Does it cover accidental death? A: Yes, it covers death due to any reason including accidents.

department: Ministry of Finance / Department of Financial Services
description: Government accident insurance scheme offering coverage for accidental death and disability at very low annual premium.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18 to 70 years having a savings bank/post office account.
benefits: Rs. 2 lakhs for accidental death or total disability; Rs. 1 lakh for partial disability. Annual premium is just Rs. 20.
incomeCriteria: No income limit
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card, Bank Account linkage, Enrollment form
applicationProcess: Enrol through your bank branch, internet banking, or mobile banking app on June 1 each year.
officeToVisit: Any Nationalized or Post Office bank branch
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: What is the yearly premium? A: Only Rs. 20 per year (auto-debited). Q: What counts as total disability? A: Loss of both eyes, both hands, or both feet.

department: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: NAPS incentivizes employers to engage apprentices by sharing part of the stipend cost, thereby expanding apprenticeship opportunities for youth across sectors.
eligibility: Indian youth aged 14+ who have passed at least Class 5. Trades range from ITI holders to graduates. Employers must be registered under the Apprentices Act.
benefits: Government shares 25% of stipend (up to Rs. 1,500/month) with employer. Apprentice receives on-the-job training with monthly stipend + National Apprenticeship Certificate upon completion.
incomeCriteria: No income limit
requiredDocuments: Educational Certificates, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account
applicationProcess: Register at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. Find employers, apply, get enrolled. Alternatively, employer can invite you directly.
officeToVisit: Regional Directorate of Apprenticeship Training (RDAT) office
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: Is this only for ITI graduates? A: No, eligibility ranges from Class 5 pass to graduates. Q: Will I get a job guarantee? A: No job guarantee but employers often absorb good performers.

department: Ministry of Finance / Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
description: A government-backed pension scheme targeting workers in the unorganized sector to provide a guaranteed minimum pension after retirement.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18–40 years. Not a beneficiary of NPS or any other statutory social security scheme. Should have a savings bank account.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum pension of Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 per month after age 60, depending on contribution. Government co-contributed 50% of contribution for first 5 years (scheme period).
incomeCriteria: No income limit; targeted at unorganized sector workers
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card, Mobile Number linked to Aadhaar, Savings Bank Account
applicationProcess: Enrol at your bank branch, internet banking, or mobile banking. Fill APY enrollment form and link to savings account for auto-debit.
officeToVisit: Any nationalized or private bank branch
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: Can I withdraw before 60? A: Premature exit allowed only in case of terminal illness or death. Q: Is it only for private sector? A: No, any Indian citizen in 18–40 age group can join.

schemeName: Dr. YSR Rythu Bharosa – PM Kisan
department: Agriculture Department, Andhra Pradesh
description: Comprehensive investment support for farmers in AP combining state assistance with PM-KISAN. Provides financial aid to farmer families including landless tenant farmers.
eligibility: Landowner farmers and SC/ST/BC/Minority landless tenant farmers of Andhra Pradesh.
benefits: Rs. 13,500 per year per farmer family (Rs. 7,500 from state + Rs. 6,000 from Central PM-KISAN). Paid in two installments.
incomeCriteria: Exclusion: Government employees, income tax payers, pensioners above Rs. 10,000/month.
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card, Land Passbook (Webland Pattadar Passbook), Bank Passbook, Mobile Number
applicationProcess: Automatic verification for landowners via Webland. Tenant farmers can register at Rythu Bharosa Kendra (RBK). No separate application needed for most beneficiaries.
officeToVisit: Rythu Bharosa Kendra (RBK) / Village Secretariat (Grama Sachivalayam)
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: Is tenant farmer eligible? A: Yes, tenant farmers officially enrolled under e-crop system are eligible. Q: When are payments made? A: Generally January-February and July-August each year.

department: Revenue Department / SERP, Andhra Pradesh
description: Monthly door-to-door pension delivery for senior citizens, widows, disabled persons, single women, fishermen, weavers, and toddy tappers in Andhra Pradesh.
eligibility: Senior citizens (60+), widows, disabled persons, single women, fishermen, weavers, toddy tappers who are BPL in Andhra Pradesh.
benefits: Monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 (general); Rs. 3,000 (disabled); Rs. 3,000 (widow). Additionally, pension beneficiaries get Aarogyasri benefits and free LPG cylinders.
incomeCriteria: BPL / White Ration Card holders; income below Rs. 10,000/month (rural) or Rs. 12,000/month (urban).
ageCriteria: 60+ for senior citizens; 18+ for widows and disabled
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card, White Ration Card, Age Proof (Voter ID/Birth Certificate), Disability Certificate (if applicable)
applicationProcess: Apply at Village/Ward Sachivalayam (Grama/Ward Volunteer). Apply using 'Mee Seva' or online at sspensions.ap.gov.in.
officeToVisit: Village/Ward Sachivalayam or Mee Seva Centre
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: How is pension paid? A: Door-to-door delivery by Village Volunteers on the 1st of each month. Q: Can someone with land own the pension? A: Eligibility is determined by White Ration Card status, not land alone.

department: School Education Department, Andhra Pradesh
description: Financial assistance directly to the mother or recognized guardian from BPL households for sending their children to school or college, to prevent dropouts and encourage full attendance.
eligibility: Mothers/guardians of students studying in Classes 1–12 in recognized schools and junior colleges in AP. Minimum 75% attendance required. Child must be enrolled in government or government-aided institution.
benefits: Rs. 15,000 per annum transferred directly to mother's bank account in January each year.
incomeCriteria: BPL households with White Ration Card
ageCriteria: Mother/Guardian must be 18+; child must be a school-going student
requiredDocuments: Mother's Aadhaar, Child's Aadhaar, Bank Account in Mother's Name, White Ration Card, School Enrollment Proof
applicationProcess: No application required. Data automatically collected through schools and verified by Village Volunteers. Attend Amma Vodi verification at your child's school.
officeToVisit: Child's School / Village / Ward Secretariat
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: What if attendance drops below 75%? A: The benefit will not be released for that year. Q: Is it for private school students? A: No, only for government and government-aided schools.

department: Health, Medical and Family Welfare Department, AP
description: State's flagship cashless health programme providing comprehensive, high-cost medical treatment for BPL families through an extensive network of empanelled government and private hospitals.
eligibility: BPL families holding valid White Ration Card (Rice Card) in Andhra Pradesh. Covers all family members.
benefits: Free cashless treatment up to Rs. 25 Lakhs per family per year for 2,648+ listed medical procedures/surgeries at empanelled hospitals. Includes transport and food allowance.
incomeCriteria: White Ration Card (BPL); Annual income below Rs. 5 Lakh
requiredDocuments: White Ration Card (Rice Card), Aadhaar Card, YSR Aarogyasri Health Card
applicationProcess: Get Aarogyasri Health Card from Village Secretariat. Present card plus Aadhaar at any empanelled hospital for treatment.
officeToVisit: Village/Ward Secretariat or any Aarogyasri network hospital
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: Is pre-authorization needed? A: Yes, for planned procedures. For emergency treatment it is post-authorized. Q: Are medicines included? A: Yes, medicines during hospitalization are covered.

department: School Education Department, Andhra Pradesh
description: Financial assistance to mothers of government/aided school students for meeting educational expenses, replacing the previous Amma Vodi scheme under the new government from 2024.
eligibility: Mothers of students in Classes 1–Intermediate (junior college) in government or government-aided schools in AP, who hold a White/Yellow Ration Card.
benefits: Rs. 15,000 per annum per eligible family directly credited to mother's linked bank account.
incomeCriteria: White or Yellow Ration Card holders
ageCriteria: Mother/Guardian 18+; Child must be enrolled in school
requiredDocuments: Mother's Aadhaar, Child's Aadhaar, School ID Card, Ration Card, Bank Passbook in Mother's Name
applicationProcess: Data collected through schools. No manual application. Verification via Village Secretariat and school records.
officeToVisit: Child's School / Village Secretariat
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: Is it released in one installment? A: Yes, generally as a single annual transfer. Q: What if student changes school? A: Ration card and Aadhaar linkage is the primary identifier — change will be updated automatically.

department: Civil Supplies Department, Andhra Pradesh
description: Provides free LPG gas cylinders to BPL women beneficiaries in AP every year under the revamped Deepam 2.0 programme launched in 2024.
eligibility: Women holding a White Ration Card (priority), an active LPG connection (PMUY or regular), and residing in Andhra Pradesh.
benefits: 3 free LPG cylinders per year (refill cost covered). Cylinder cost is directly transferred to beneficiary's bank account as DBT.
incomeCriteria: White Ration Card holders; Annual household income below Rs. 1,20,000
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card, LPG Consumer Number / Passbook, White Ration Card, Bank Passbook
applicationProcess: Verification done via Grama/Ward Sachivalayam. Eligible beneficiaries are identified automatically. Visit Village Secretariat for any corrections.
officeToVisit: Grama/Ward Sachivalayam (Village Secretariat) or Gas Agency
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: When are the cylinders distributed? A: Typically 3 times a year (Ugadi, August 15, and January). Q: Do I need to apply? A: No new application needed if already a White Ration Card holder with LPG connection.

department: BC Welfare Department, Andhra Pradesh
description: Financial empowerment scheme providing annual financial assistance to BC, SC, ST, and minority women aged 45–60 years to start or sustain livelihood activities.
eligibility: Women from backward classes (BC), SC, ST, and Minority communities aged 45–60 years with annual family income below Rs. 1.5 Lakh in AP.
benefits: Rs. 18,750 per year (Rs. 75,000 over four years) credited directly to beneficiary's bank account.
incomeCriteria: Annual family income below Rs. 1,50,000
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card, Caste Certificate, Income Certificate, Bank Passbook, White Ration Card
applicationProcess: Apply at Village/Ward Sachivalayam. Verification by local volunteers and online approval.
officeToVisit: Village/Ward Sachivalayam or BC Welfare Office
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: Is it a one-time payment? A: No, it is Rs. 18,750 per year for 4 years (total Rs. 75,000). Q: Can a widow apply? A: Yes, if she meets the age, caste, and income criteria.

department: Higher Education Department, Andhra Pradesh
description: Complete fee reimbursement for students in ITI, Polytechnic, Degree, Engineering, Medicine, Pharmacy, Law, MBA, MCA, and other professional courses in government and private aided colleges.
eligibility: Students from BC, SC, ST, Minority, EWS, and Kapu communities studying in recognized colleges in AP.
benefits: 100% tuition fee reimbursement directly into mother's bank account. Covers engineering, medicine, law, MBA, polytechnic, ITI, and more.
incomeCriteria: Annual family income up to Rs. 2.5 Lakh (for most categories); SC/ST up to Rs. 2.5 Lakh; BC/EWS up to Rs. 1.5 Lakh
requiredDocuments: Student's Aadhaar, Mother's Aadhaar, Caste Certificate, Income Certificate, College Fee Receipt, Bank Passbook (Mother's account), Previous Year Marksheets
applicationProcess: Apply online at jaganannavidyadeevena.ap.gov.in or through the college. College verifies and forwards application.
officeToVisit: College/Institution or Village Secretariat for document verification
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: Is it for private colleges? A: Yes, it covers both government and private aided colleges. Q: What if I take a gap year? A: Eligibility is per-year enrolment; reapplication required each academic year.

department: Higher Education Department, Andhra Pradesh
description: Provides hostel fees and boarding expenses for students staying in hostels while pursuing higher education, ensuring no dropout due to financial hardship.
eligibility: Students from BC, SC, ST, Minority, EWS, and Kapu communities studying in government and aided colleges and living in hostels outside their native village/town.
benefits: Rs. 10,000–20,000 per year (based on course and hostel type) credited to mother's bank account for hostel and board expenses.
incomeCriteria: Annual family income up to Rs. 2.5 Lakh
requiredDocuments: Student and Mother's Aadhaar, Caste Certificate, Income Certificate, Hostel Allotment Letter, Bank Passbook (Mother's account)
applicationProcess: Apply through college or at jaganannavidyadeevena.ap.gov.in (combined portal with Vidya Deevena).
officeToVisit: College/Institution or BC/SC/ST Welfare Office
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: Is it for day scholars? A: No, only for hostel residents. Q: Can students in private hostels apply? A: Only recognized hostels affiliated/approved by the institution are covered.

department: Housing Department, Andhra Pradesh
description: State housing scheme to provide free, fully constructed houses to the homeless and houseless poor and BPL families in Andhra Pradesh.
eligibility: Families that are homeless or live in kutcha (temporary) houses in AP and have White Ration Card. Once allotted, ineligible to reapply.
benefits: Free 2-bedroom house (approx. 270 sq. ft. built-up area with kitchen, toilet, electricity, water connection). No loan or repayment required.
incomeCriteria: BPL / White Ration Card holders
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card, White Ration Card, Proof of Living in Kutcha House, Bank Passbook
applicationProcess: Applications accepted during designated drives. Apply at Village Secretariat / Grama Sachivalayam. Allotment by lottery/survey.
officeToVisit: Village/Ward Secretariat (Grama Sachivalayam) or Housing Office
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: Is there any cost to the beneficiary? A: No cost — house is given free. Q: How long does it take? A: Construction timeline depends on land availability; typically 12–24 months after allotment.

schemeName: YSR Sunna Vaddi (Zero Interest Loans for SHGs)
department: Rural Development / SERP, Andhra Pradesh
description: Andhra Pradesh waives all interest on bank loans taken by Self-Help Groups (SHGs) through DWCRA. The state government bears the full interest burden.
eligibility: Women SHG members who have availed bank linkage loans under SERP or NRLM in Andhra Pradesh.
benefits: Complete interest waiver on SHG bank loans (state government pays the interest to banks). SHG members need to repay only the principal amount.
incomeCriteria: BPL/marginalized rural women
requiredDocuments: SHG Passbook / Group ID, Aadhaar Card, Bank Loan Documents
applicationProcess: No application required. State SERP automatically processes interest subvention through participating banks.
officeToVisit: SERP District Office / Block Mission Management Unit (BMMU)
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: Is it for all SHGs? A: Only SHGs with active, performing bank linkage loans. Irregular/defaulting groups may not qualify. Q: Is it applicable on new loans too? A: Yes, new loans after the scheme launch are also covered.

schemeName: AP Free Bus Travel for Women (APSRTC)
department: Transport Department / APSRTC, Andhra Pradesh
description: Provides free bus travel to all women on ordinary and express APSRTC buses across Andhra Pradesh to enhance mobility and economic participation.
eligibility: All women residents of Andhra Pradesh. No income, age, or caste restriction.
benefits: Zero ticket cost for all women on APSRTC ordinary, fast, and express services (excludes luxury / non-APSRTC buses).
incomeCriteria: No income restriction
requiredDocuments: Any valid Photo ID proving AP residency (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Ration Card)
applicationProcess: No application needed. Show valid AP ID proof to bus conductor and board for free travel.
officeToVisit: Any APSRTC bus stand
frequentlyAskedQuestions: Q: Do I need a special pass? A: No pass needed, just a valid AP ID proof. Q: Does it apply to AC or sleeper buses? A: No, only ordinary, fast, and express APSRTC services.
